extraction.notes: Three-month column ended Dec 31, 2022. FFO total is the 'FFO' line (377,940, before preferred distributions); the preferred distributions (772) appear as a deduction and an add-back between FFO and FFO available to Common Shares and Units, so they net to zero and are omitted from the bridge. Core total is 'Normalized FFO' (367,581) before preferred distributions. Zero-valued lines (printed as '—') are included with amount 0. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' categorized as other since it does not fit a listed category. EQR reports no AFFO metric. Recurring capex: the only capex table (page 25, seq 30) is full-year 2022 ('Replacements' 52,745 total), with no current-quarter figure, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted shares 390,245 reproduces FFO/share 0.97 (377,940/390,245) and Normalized FFO/share 0.94 (367,581/390,245).
